label: setup
js: (() => { window.__st = () => { const s = __kk.puzzles.state; const k = __kk.kitten.body.pos, n = __kk.knight.body.pos; return JSON.stringify({ pin: s.pinOut, jam: s.jammed, snag: s.snagCleared, drained: s.drained, held: s.portHeld, rel: s.released, castle: s.castleReached, water: +__kk.physics.waterLevel.toFixed(2), prompt: __kk.puzzles.prompt, ch: __kk.story().chapter, trust: __kk.story().trust, k: [k.x, k.y, k.z].map(v => +v.toFixed(2)), n: [n.x, n.y, n.z].map(v => +v.toFixed(2)) }); }; document.querySelector('#hud .title').style.display = 'none'; __kk.skip(); return 'ok'; })()

label: kitten into hut
js: (() => { const L = { hutX: -26.2, hutZ: -86.9 }; __kk.teleport('kitten', L.hutX + 0.2, L.hutZ, -Math.PI / 2); __kk.teleport('knight', -27.4 + 1.3, -84 + 0.75 + 0.35, -Math.PI / 2); __kk.setActive('kitten'); return __st(); })()

label: knight at gate
js: (() => { const G = { x: -51.2, z: -103.5 }; __kk.teleport('knight', G.x, G.z + 1.2, Math.PI); __kk.teleport('kitten', G.x + 0.6, G.z + 1.6, Math.PI); __kk.setActive('knight'); return __st(); })()

label: held
js: (() => { const P = __kk.physics; const G = { x: -51.2, z: -103.5 }; const y = __kk.kitten.body.pos.y; return __st() + ' kittenBlocked=' + P.segmentBlocked(G.x + 0.5, G.z + 0.8, G.x + 0.5, G.z - 0.8, 0.08, y + 0.1, y + 0.3, 2) + ' knightBlocked=' + P.segmentBlocked(G.x + 0.5, G.z + 0.8, G.x + 0.5, G.z - 0.8, 0.3, y + 0.3, y + 1.8, 1); })()

label: kitten under
js: (() => { __kk.switchChar(); const G = { x: -51.2, innerZ: -106.4 }; __kk.teleport('kitten', G.x - 0.7, G.innerZ + 1.3, -Math.PI / 2); return __st(); })()

label: through
js: (() => { const G = { x: -51.2, innerZ: -106.4 }; __kk.teleport('kitten', G.x - 0.4, G.innerZ - 3, Math.PI); __kk.teleport('knight', G.x + 0.5, G.innerZ - 3.4, Math.PI); return __st(); })()
